# Vendored v8unpack

Windows `v8unpack.exe` is shipped with parse-1c-build so clients do not pick up
an unrelated copy from PATH or from a user `settings.yaml`.

- Version: 3.2.0 (built by Cujoko)
- Upstream: https://github.com/cujoko/v8unpack
